title: Guava Flow Cytometry Cleaning
author: Steven W Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iwbcfan

steps.title: Run initial normal cleaning cycle
steps.instruction: Run a NORMAL cleaning cycle before the first run of the day. If no liquid is seen flowing into the waste vial, power down the instrument, remove the cover plate, and clean each silicone tube to and from the pump with heated MQ using a syringe before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: If liquid does not flow to waste vial, power down the machine.
Flush each silicone tube with heated MQ via syringe.

steps.title: Start sample run, check for bubbles
steps.instruction: Begin the sample run. During the adjust‑settings stage, verify that no air bubbles are present in the line above the capillary tube.

steps.title: Post‑run cleaning and capillary decision
steps.instruction: Immediately after completing the run, perform a cleaning cycle. If another user is scheduled within the next 2 hours, leave the instrument in capillary‑shutdown mode; otherwise continue with the end‑of‑day cleaning steps.

substeps.instruction: If next user ≤ 2 h away, set machine to capillary shutdown.
If no user within 2 h, proceed to steps 4‑6.

steps.title: Prepare hot MQ and buffer solutions
steps.instruction: Retrieve the beakers labeled “MQ” and “Phosphate Buffer” from the cabinet. Aliquot approximately 10–15 mL of each liquid into its respective beaker and heat both beakers to boiling in a microwave for use in the cleaning cycles.

substeps.instruction: Collect MQ and Phosphate Buffer beakers.
Aliquot ~10‑15 mL MQ into MQ beaker.
Aliquot ~10‑15 mL Phosphate Buffer into its beaker.
Microwave both beakers until the liquids reach boiling.

steps.title: Load cleaning reagents into tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense the following into the indicated 2 mL tubes:

substeps.instruction: Tube 9: 1.5 mL MQ for capillary shutdown

steps.title: Execute final normal cleaning cycle
steps.instruction: Heat another 10–15 mL of MQ to boiling and run a second NORMAL cleaning cycle to flush residual phosphate buffer from the pump and tubing, preventing salt buildup.

substeps.instruction: Run NORMAL cleaning cycle using the hot MQ.
